feeds.title: Archi-QS Blog
feeds.description: We cover a variety of topics about the construction industry including project management and quantity surveying. Archi-QS is an award-winning, family-owned and operated business, that helps clients navigate the requirements of local councils, state authorities, financial institutions, and strata regulations to ensure every project reaches fruition and exceeds expectations.

feeds.title: Cooper & Hall Blog
feeds.description: Cooper & Hall has been providing quantity surveying services nationwide since 2002, giving no-nonsense, effective advice in construction consultancy. Keep yourself updated with all the latest news in the construction world from our blog.

feeds.title: W6 Partners Blog
feeds.description: W6 Partners Academy is the first 100% online learning and coaching platform which is focused on providing Quantity Surveyors and Cost Managers with marketable skills to accelerate their careers with the goal of preparing our learners for top employment opportunities.

feeds.title: HMS Group Blog
feeds.description: As a Construction Consultancy company, HMS Group, provides tailored services to help clients maximize profit on the property, commercial and infrastructure projects. HMS Group uses our problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and in-depth construction experience to provide value engineering advice, and expert witness reports in conjunction with creating accurate, conforming tender quantities. Get the latest information & updates regarding quantity surveyors Australia in the blog section of HMS Group.

feeds.title: Alexander Executive Search Blog
feeds.description: Our civil engineering Quantity Surveyor Recruitment Blog gives a market perspective on what is happening today - across all the civil engineering, rail, and energy recruitment disciplines. The blog is where we talk about the real-world challenges, issues, and technical developments we must deal with within the recruitment market.

feeds.title: Quantity Surveying Coach
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Alastair Carey. Learn quantity surveying online today! Our quantity surveyor courses are the best in the world, our qs course will give you the knowledge and skills to succeed as a quantity surveyor. The Quantity Surveying Coach blog is a resource for quantity surveyors of all experience levels. Get tips and advice on a variety of quantity surveying topics, from estimating to construction law.

feeds.title: ProQS
feeds.description: ProQS Ltd, leading Chartered Quantity Surveyors based in Colchester provides insights into Quantity Surveying and gives information about recent Contract Surveying projects. ProQS is a chartered firm of Quantity Surveyors regulated by the RICS operating from Colchester across Essex into London and beyond.
